hypothesis: A local-tool capability must bind to the exact observed executable artifact, not only a pathname, because same-path binary drift between successful probes and a later capability read can otherwise leave stale competence actionable.

pre_fix_code_path.reason: tool presence stored only resolved path/version metadata; probes reopened that pathname; current_capability did not compare current executable bytes against the artifact that produced the successful trials
pre_fix_code_path.possible_effect: same-path executable replacement could preserve an old CAN_DELEGATE receipt until freshness expiry

mechanism: observe resolved executable artifact with SHA-256 and filesystem identity
self-verify LOCAL_TOOL presence rather than trusting caller-supplied artifact fields
open exact observed artifact and execute via inherited /proc/self/fd handle so pathname replacement after verification cannot change the bytes executed by the probe
current capability reads compare current artifact identity and fail closed to UNKNOWN on drift/unavailability
re-observing changed executable identity starts a new trial_generation so old successes cannot transfer to new bytes
repair.authority_boundary: artifact-bound CAN_DELEGATE remains capability evidence only and never effect or Harness authority

regression_gate.scenario: same executable pathname earns CAN_DELEGATE on v1 bytes, bytes are replaced in place, current read and probe must return UNKNOWN, re-observation must start at zero effective trials, and only two probes of v2 bytes may restore CAN_DELEGATE while raw v1 history remains preserved
